chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Yazeed ibn Khalifa, who said:

I complained to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), saying, 'I get a headache when I fast these three days, and it is difficult for me.' He (peace be upon him) said, 'Do as I do when I travel. For when I travel, I give in charity for each day a Mudd of the food of my family with which I provide them.'

key_terms.أُصَدَّعُ: I get a headache / suffer from splitting headache
key_terms.قُوتِ أَهْلِي: The staple food/subsistence of my family
key_terms.مُدٍّ: A Mudd, a traditional measure of volume for food (approx. 750g)

ai.seo_question: How to compensate for missed fasts due to difficulty or illness according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the principle of *Fidyah* (compensation) for those unable to fast due to chronic or temporary hardship, such as persistent headaches. Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) models the ruling on his own practice during travel, specifying the compensation as one Mudd of the family's staple food, thereby linking personal piety with legal precedent. This ruling underscores the Shia scholarly emphasis on ease (*Yusr*) in jurisprudence, allowing for financial redemption when physical fasting becomes excessively burdensome.

en.hubeali: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Safwan Bin Yahya, from Yazeed Bin Khaleefa who said,

‘I complained to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, so I said, ‘I tend to get a headache when I Fast these three days, and it is grievous upon me’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘So you should do just as I<sup>asws</sup> do when I<sup>asws</sup> travel. So I<sup>asws</sup>, when I<sup>asws</sup> travel, give in charity for each day with a Mudd (approximately 750g. of food) of daily subsistence of my<sup>asws</sup> family which I<sup>asws</sup> tend to provide them with’.
en.sarwar: 6. Abu Ali al-Ash’ariy has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Abd al-Jabbar from Safwan ibn Yahya from Yazid ibn Khalifah who has said the following:

“I once complained before abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, saying, ‘I get a headache if I fast the three days (recommended for every month) and it is difficult for me. He (the Imam) said, ‘You must do as I do when I travel. When traveling I pay charity for every day of one mud (a certain measurement) of the kind of food which is used in my family.’”
